description: Comptage trafic routier is a dataset listed in data.gouv.nc open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Gouvernement de la Nouvelle-Calédonie. Un compteur automatique détecte et enregistre les variations de pression dans un tube creux en caoutchouc qui traverse la chaussée. Ces variations sont dues au passage d’essieux écrasant le tube. Il détermine donc le nombre d’essieux qui passe sur la chaussée. Coverage: New Caledonia. The portal files it under Territory Development, Infrastructure, Territory, Transport, Mobility. Its keywords are comptage, route, trafic, taux moyen journalier, TMJ, véhicule léger. The portal shows 2026-07-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-gouv-nc-portal.
